hashScope: Files selected by scripts/source-state.ts; not a Git commit, binary or memory-image hash.

preflightPrompt.scope: Registered callback and SDK prompt construction; no real provider request or model-adherence measurement.

localScope.scope: Prompt and metadata only; not a runtime path interceptor. A remote path string that also exists locally can still be operated on.

rawEvidence.reason: Local receipts include machine paths, OS item IDs and unrelated workspace metadata; originals are preserved privately.

limitations: No independent advisor approval is claimed.
Long real-time expiry and recycle retention were not waited out.
Validation maxima do not establish maximum-capacity throughput.
Linux native integration requires a Linux host.
Preflight verification does not establish real provider payload delivery or model adherence.
Later full-prompt replacement handlers can still override prior guidance.
Recreating Windows file/directory symbolic links requires OS permission; unavailable privilege is reported or skipped, never enabled by the plugin.
Relative link targets are preserved verbatim and resolve relative to the restored location.
Local-scope wording is guidance and documentation, not enforcement; none of the six tools inspects SSH state or rejects remote-looking paths.
